summary: Phase-5 testing of Manual Composer (/admin/compose) + upload-image + /api/news/manual. 39/39 backend pytest tests pass (added 9 new for upload-image auth/success/non-image-reject/oversize-reject, news/manual auth, pending-review path, direct-publish path with public-feed verification, empty-content rejection). Playwright validated end-to-end: login → compose-nav-btn → fill title/body/category → upload PNG (preview visible via compose-image-preview) → compose-publish-btn navigates to public feed where story shows (toast 'खबर सीधे प्रकाशित हो गई' visible). compose-review-btn creates Pending_Review item and returns to /admin where it is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: upload_image reads full file into memory before size check — a malicious client can stream >6MB and OOM the worker. Should enforce size via Content-Length / chunked read with a hard cap.

upload_image accepts any file.content_type the client claims (image/*). No magic-byte sniffing — a .exe could be stored as image/jpeg. Consider `imghdr` / Pillow verify, or at least a MIME sniff on the first N bytes.

/api/news/manual publish=true copies original_title/content verbatim to rewritten_* and marks Published. There is no HTML sanitization — admin-pasted content could inject <script> if the public feed ever renders HTML (currently plain text, safe for now).

ManualNews allows image_url to be any arbitrary string (including external http URLs or garbage). Composer only uses hosted /api/images/... but the API itself does not restrict — consider validating prefix for consistency with the 'own hosted images only' story.
No cleanup of orphaned /api/images objects when a news item is deleted — object storage will grow unbounded. Low priority but worth noting.
Compose.jsx mounts GET /api/categories without AbortController; fast unmount could leak the request. Minor.
Still open from prior iterations: AdminDashboard.jsx > 500 lines, CORS_ORIGINS='*', no auth rate-limit, backfill asyncio.create_task not bounded.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_PLAY_* items during Playwright run; cleaned up post-test (verified removed=2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Composer page is at /admin/compose. Nav from Admin dashboard via data-testid=compose-nav-btn. Testids: compose-title-input, compose-body-input, compose-category-select, compose-source-input, compose-image-input (hidden; use set_input_files on it directly, do not click the dropzone label), compose-image-preview, compose-remove-image, compose-review-btn, compose-rewrite-btn, compose-publish-btn. Publish navigates to '/' (public feed), review and rewrite navigate to '/admin'. /api/upload-image returns {url:'/api/images/samvad/news/<uuid>.ext'}. /api/news/manual with publish=true requires non-empty content (400 otherwise), copies original_title->rewritten_title verbatim and sets published_at + status=Published.
